caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of white fabric set against a blank, off-white background. The fabric has an ornamental cutwork pattern concentrated along one edge, which is scalloped and detailed with fine white stitching. The decorative design consists of a spiral formed by a repeating leaf motif, each leaf outlined with purple shading, and is surrounded by two arcs of evenly spaced small circular holes, each also shaded in purple, creating a floral or botanical effect. The rest of the fabric is unembellished, with clean, straight top and side edges contrasting the intricately scalloped and embroidered bottom edge. The name "J. Swanson" is written in small, neat script in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Eyelet Embroidery
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
